## LOAD AND CORRECT PHYLOSEQ OBJECTS

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}
# Sample 89 is a duplicate of 88 (lower sequencing depth, excluded)
# Sample 398R is a re-extraction of 398; rename to merge

apply_corrections <- function(ps) {
  ps <- ps %>%
    subset_samples(Lab_Code != "89") %>%
    removeZeros()
  sample_data(ps)$Lab_Code[sample_data(ps)$Lab_Code == "398R"] <- "398"
  ps
}

# Microbiome (all Fringilla)
microb_fr <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/ps_OTU99_wAlpha_fr_taxFix.rds")) %>%
  subset_samples(Genus == "Fringilla") %>%
  apply_corrections()

# Microbiome (Fringilla with diet overlap)
microb_overlap_diet <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/microb_overlap_OTU99_fr_taxFix.rds")) %>%
  subset_samples(Genus == "Fringilla") %>%
  apply_corrections()

# Diet (all Fringilla)
diet_fr <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/ps_diet_rarefied.rds")) %>%
  subset_samples(Genus == "Fringilla") %>%
  apply_corrections()

# Diet (Fringilla with microbiome overlap)
diet_overlap_microb <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/diet_overlap_OTU99_fr.rds")) %>%
  apply_corrections()

# WGS (Fringilla, microbiome-overlap, excluding low-quality WGS samples)
wgs_qc_exclude <- c("132", "252")
wgs_fr <- microb_fr %>%
  subset_samples(WGS_data == 1 & !Lab_Code %in% wgs_qc_exclude)

wgs_microb <- microb_overlap_diet %>%
  subset_samples(WGS_data == 1 & !Lab_Code %in% wgs_qc_exclude)

# Sanity check
nrow(sample_data(microb_fr)) # 234
nrow(sample_data(diet_fr)) # 276
nrow(sample_data(microb_overlap_diet)) # 208
nrow(sample_data(diet_overlap_microb)) # 208
nrow(sample_data(wgs_fr)) # 106
nrow(sample_data(wgs_microb)) # 103
```

## VERIFY SAMPLE SIZES

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}
diet_codes <- sample_data(diet_fr)$Lab_Code
microb_codes <- sample_data(microb_fr)$Lab_Code
wgs_codes <- sample_data(wgs_fr)$Lab_Code

# Total unique birds: should be 302
length(unique(c(diet_codes, microb_codes, wgs_codes)))

# Set differences
length(setdiff(diet_codes, microb_codes)) # 68 diet-only
length(setdiff(microb_codes, diet_codes)) # 26 microb-only
length(setdiff(wgs_codes, microb_codes)) # 0  (all WGS birds in microbiome)
length(setdiff(wgs_codes, diet_codes)) # 3  (3 WGS birds without diet)
```

## PER-POPULATION SUMMARY TABLE

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}
# Build per-bird presence indicators
diet_df <- data.frame(
  Lab_Code = sample_data(diet_fr)$Lab_Code,
  Species_Label = gsub(" ", "_", sample_data(diet_fr)$Species_Label),
  in_diet = TRUE
)

microb_df <- data.frame(
  Lab_Code = sample_data(microb_fr)$Lab_Code,
  Species_Label = gsub(" ", "_", sample_data(microb_fr)$Species_Label),
  in_microb = TRUE
)

wgs_df <- data.frame(
  Lab_Code = sample_data(wgs_fr)$Lab_Code,
  Species_Label = gsub(" ", "_", sample_data(wgs_fr)$Species_Label),
  in_wgs = TRUE
)

all_birds <- bind_rows(diet_df, microb_df, wgs_df) %>%
  group_by(Lab_Code, Species_Label) %>%
  summarise(
    in_diet = any(in_diet, na.rm = TRUE),
    in_microb = any(in_microb, na.rm = TRUE),
    in_wgs = any(in_wgs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("in_"), ~ replace_na(., FALSE)))

# Per-population counts
summary_table <- all_birds %>%
  group_by(Species_Label) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_samples = n(),
    N_microbiome = sum(in_microb),
    N_diet = sum(in_diet),
    N_WGS = sum(in_wgs),
    Diet_and_Microb = sum(in_diet & in_microb),
    All_three = sum(in_diet & in_microb & in_wgs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Verify totals (should be 302, 234, 276, 106, 208, 103)
summary_table %>% summarise(
  total       = sum(Total_samples),
  micro       = sum(N_microbiome),
  diet        = sum(N_diet),
  wgs         = sum(N_WGS),
  diet_microb = sum(Diet_and_Microb),
  all_three   = sum(All_three)
)

# Add metadata
bird_metadata <- data.frame(
  Species_Label = gsub(" ", "_", sample_data(diet_fr)$Species_Label),
  Archipelago_Mainland = sample_data(diet_fr)$Archipelago_Mainland,
  Island_Mainland = sample_data(diet_fr)$Island_Mainland,
  Genus = sample_data(diet_fr)$Genus,
  Species = sample_data(diet_fr)$Species,
  Subspecies = sample_data(diet_fr)$Subspecies,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% distinct(Species_Label, .keep_all = TRUE)

summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  left_join(bird_metadata, by = "Species_Label") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Archipelago_Mainland, Island_Mainland, Genus, Species, Subspecies,
    Total_samples, N_microbiome, N_diet, N_WGS,
    Diet_and_Microb, All_three
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(Archipelago_Mainland,
      levels = c("Mainland", "Azores", "Madeira", "Canary Islands")
    ),
    Island_Mainland
  )

write.csv(summary_table,
  file = paste0(outputDir, "/sample_summary_per_population.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## CREATE SUPPLEMENTARY METADATA TABLE

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}
## CREATE SUPPLEMENTARY METADATA TABLE

# --- Pull sample_data tables, coerce Lab_Code to character for safe joins ---
sd_microb <- as(sample_data(microb_fr), "data.frame") %>%
  mutate(Lab_Code = as.character(Lab_Code))
sd_diet   <- as(sample_data(diet_fr),   "data.frame") %>%
  mutate(Lab_Code = as.character(Lab_Code))
sd_wgs    <- as(sample_data(wgs_fr),    "data.frame") %>%
  mutate(Lab_Code = as.character(Lab_Code))

microb_codes <- unique(sd_microb$Lab_Code)
diet_codes   <- unique(sd_diet$Lab_Code)
wgs_codes    <- unique(sd_wgs$Lab_Code)

# --- Harmonize diet Sex coding to character (1=male, 2=female) ---
# Verified against sd_microb: Lab_Code 105/101/100 = male = 1; Lab_Code 106 = female = 2.
sd_diet <- sd_diet %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = case_when(
      as.character(Sex) == "1" ~ "male",
      as.character(Sex) == "2" ~ "female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

AccessionNumber_df <- read.csv("~/Dropbox/FringillaMicrobiome/13_ENA/02_runs/Prepare_run_submission_ENA.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")

head(AccessionNumber_df)


ROH_data <- read.csv(paste0(dataDir, "/fringilla_microbiome_roh_rg_filtered.csv"))

head(ROH_data)

# --- Build the merged base table ---
# Slim each frame to the columns we need, then harmonize Year.
# any_of() silently drops columns that don't exist in a given frame
# (e.g. diet_fr has no Date / Island_Province / Age_cat),
# so those become NA for diet-only birds after bind_rows.

keep_cols <- c("Lab_Code", "Ring",
               "Genus", "Species", "Subspecies",
               "Date", "Month", "Year",
               "Ydec", "Xdec",
               "Island_Province", "Archipelago_Mainland", "Island_Mainland",
               "Sex", "Age_cat")

shrink <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(any_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Year)),
      Ydec = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Ydec)),
      Xdec = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Xdec))
    )
}
sd_microb_min <- shrink(sd_microb)
sd_diet_min   <- shrink(sd_diet)
sd_wgs_min    <- shrink(sd_wgs)

diet_only_rows <- sd_diet_min %>% filter(!Lab_Code %in% microb_codes)
wgs_only_rows  <- sd_wgs_min  %>% filter(!Lab_Code %in% microb_codes,
                                         !Lab_Code %in% diet_only_rows$Lab_Code)

supp_meta <- bind_rows(sd_microb_min, diet_only_rows, wgs_only_rows) %>%
  distinct(Lab_Code, .keep_all = TRUE)

 

# --- Re-derive dataset-inclusion indicators from actual phyloseq membership ---
# (overwrites the WGS_data / diet_data columns inherited from microb_fr so they
# reflect post-correction, post-QC inclusion)
supp_meta <- supp_meta %>%
  mutate(
    microb_data = as.integer(Lab_Code %in% microb_codes),
    diet_data   = as.integer(Lab_Code %in% diet_codes),
    WGS_data    = as.integer(Lab_Code %in% wgs_codes)
  )

# --- Join ENA accession from AccessionNumber_df (key: Ring) ---
acc_lookup <- AccessionNumber_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Ring, accession) %>%
  distinct(Ring, .keep_all = TRUE)

supp_meta <- supp_meta %>%
  left_join(acc_lookup, by = "Ring")

roh_lookup <- ROH_data %>%
  mutate(Lab_Code = sub("_.*", "", file_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Lab_Code, ROH_coef = froh) %>%
  distinct(Lab_Code, .keep_all = TRUE)

supp_meta <- supp_meta %>%
  left_join(roh_lookup, by = "Lab_Code")


# --- Order columns to match the supplementary template ---
supp_meta <- supp_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    accession,
    Lab_Code,
    Ring,
    Genus, Species, Subspecies,
    Date, Month, Year,
    Ydec, Xdec,
    Island_Province,
    Archipelago_Mainland,
    Island_Mainland,
    Sex,
    Age_cat,
    microb_data,
    diet_data,
    WGS_data,
    ROH_coef
    # ROH_coef -- add here once we know its source
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Archipelago_Mainland,
                 levels = c("Mainland", "Azores", "Madeira", "Canary Islands")),
          Island_Mainland, Genus, Species, Subspecies)

# --- Sanity checks: totals ---
nrow(supp_meta)                                                       # 302
sum(supp_meta$microb_data)                                            # 234
sum(supp_meta$diet_data)                                              # 276
sum(supp_meta$WGS_data)                                               # 106
sum(supp_meta$microb_data & supp_meta$diet_data)                      # 208
sum(supp_meta$microb_data & supp_meta$diet_data & supp_meta$WGS_data) # 103

# --- Audit: diet-only birds will have NA for columns missing in diet_fr ---
diet_only_check <- supp_meta %>% filter(microb_data == 0 & diet_data == 1)
nrow(diet_only_check)                          # expect 68
sum(is.na(diet_only_check$Date))               # expect 68
sum(is.na(diet_only_check$Island_Province))    # expect 68
sum(is.na(diet_only_check$Age_cat))            # expect 68

supp_meta %>% filter(is.na(accession)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Lab_Code, Ring, Genus, Species, microb_data, diet_data, WGS_data)


# Re-check
sum(is.na(supp_meta$accession))   # should be 0


supp_meta <- supp_meta %>%
  mutate(accession = if_else(Lab_Code == "280" & is.na(accession),
                             "ERS16447430",
                             accession))

# Re-check
sum(is.na(supp_meta$accession))   # should be 0


supp_meta %>% filter(Lab_Code == "280") %>%
  dplyr::select(accession, Lab_Code, Ring, Genus, Species, Date, Island_Mainland)


write.csv(supp_meta,
          file = paste0(outputDir, "/sample_metadata_supplementary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## MEAN ROH PER POPULATION

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE}

# Subset to birds with a ROH value (WGS subset, post rg-filtering)
roh_pop <- supp_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(ROH_coef)) %>%
  mutate(Subspecies = ifelse(is.na(Subspecies), "", Subspecies)) %>%
  group_by(Archipelago_Mainland, Island_Mainland, Genus, Species, Subspecies) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    mean_ROH   = mean(ROH_coef),
    sd_ROH     = sd(ROH_coef),
    se_ROH     = sd_ROH / sqrt(n),
    CI95_lower = mean_ROH - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se_ROH,
    CI95_upper = mean_ROH + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se_ROH,
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Archipelago_Mainland,
                 levels = c("Mainland", "Azores", "Madeira", "Canary Islands")),
          Island_Mainland, Genus, Species, Subspecies)

# Sanity check: total n should match supp_meta WGS count with non-NA ROH
sum(roh_pop$n)                                                  # n WGS birds with ROH
sum(!is.na(supp_meta$ROH_coef))                                 # should match
sum(!is.na(supp_meta$ROH_coef) & supp_meta$WGS_data == 1)       # should also match

# Round for export
roh_pop_out <- roh_pop %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_ROH, sd_ROH, se_ROH, CI95_lower, CI95_upper),
                ~ round(., 4)))

write.csv(roh_pop_out,
          file = paste0(outputDir, "/ROH_per_population.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

roh_pop_out
```
